places.note: Pink-and-green Cajun-Creole bar on Main St with one of Midtown's best patios. Houston Press Best Bar; trivia, drag brunch, karaoke and a holiday Miracle pop-up. Card only.
places.tryit: Fried-chicken Crunchwrap 2.0, lemon pepper wings or a shrimp po-boy; brunch on weekends.

places.name: Hudson House Rice Village
places.note: Rice Village outpost of the East-Coast-style seafood and burger spot: lobster rolls, raw bar and martinis.
places.tryit: Lobster roll and fries with a martini.

places.name: Milton's
places.note: Red-sauce Italian date-night spot in Rice Village: fried gulf shrimp and calamari, bolognese and a chicken parm buried in marinara.
places.tryit: Chicken parm and the bolognese to share.

places.name: Local Foods Rice Village
places.note: Rice Village original of the farm-to-table sandwich and salad spot, with Lee's Den wine and cocktail bar upstairs.
places.tryit: Crunchy chicken sandwich, then a glass upstairs at Lee's.

places.name: Lee's Den
places.note: Speakeasy-style wine and cocktail bar upstairs at Local Foods in Rice Village; 21+, pasta specials Wednesdays and steak night Thursdays. Named one of Bon Appétit's 2025 Best Bars in America.
places.tryit: Thursday steak night or a martini at the bar.

places.name: Fancy's HTX
places.address: 1947 W Gray St Suite 200, Houston, TX
places.note: Upscale River Oaks cocktail lounge and dinner spot upstairs on W Gray, from the Off The Record team: live musicians, DJs and a dressy crowd. Wed–Sat nights; formal attire.
places.tryit: The "Oh You Fancy Huh?" cocktail; book ahead for Wednesday nights.

places.name: iPic Houston
places.address: 4444 Westheimer Rd Suite G100, Houston, TX
places.note: Luxury dine-in movie theater in River Oaks District: recliners with full-service food and cocktails at your seat, plus a bar for before or after the film.
places.tryit: Book a premium pod and order before the trailers end.

places.name: MAD
places.address: 4444 Westheimer Rd Suite C180, Houston, TX
places.note: Modern Spanish tapas in River Oaks District from the team behind Michelin-starred BCN, known for its gin & tonics and paella.
places.tryit: Seafood paella and a gin & tonic; weekend brunch Fri–Sun.

places.name: Uchi
places.note: Tyson Cole's modern Japanese flagship in a converted Montrose house: inventive raw plates, nigiri and tasting menus.
places.tryit: Happy hour 'sake social' early; the hama chili and a chef's tasting.

places.name: Aiko
places.note: Modern Japanese sushi bar and omakase on Washington Ave from chefs Patrick Pham and Daniel Lee (Kokoro, Handies Douzo).
places.tryit: Hamachi crudo, spicy tuna handroll and saketoro aburi nigiri.

places.name: Kirby Ice House
places.note: Big Upper Kirby icehouse with a huge backyard, local beers on tap, TVs for games and food trucks.
places.tryit: A local draft in the backyard on game day.

places.name: Local Foods
places.note: Heights location of the farm-to-table sandwich and salad favorite.
places.tryit: The crunchy chicken sandwich and a side of the market salads.
